items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I sold the rights to Orrin Keepnews and his partner... forming a friendship that lasts to this day with the surviving member, Orrin Keepnews.

ctx.x: I sold the rights to Orrin Keepnews and his partner, the one who died. I can see his face before me, with the glasses and everything. They had a company that they called – oh gee, isn’t that terrible? I can’t remember the name of it. Could it have been Riverside, even then? Later it became Riverside, because they had their office in the basement of a building near Riverside Drive on LaSalle Street, at the corner of Morning- – not Morningside Drive. It’s the street parallel to Broadway between Broadway and…
